§6§lGetting Familiar with the UI§r
§7Hover your mouse over parts of 
§7the image to learn more!

hotspots.title: Wiki Button
hotspots.body: Access this in-game wiki anytime with this button

hotspots.title: Redstone Links
hotspots.body: Set up to 20 frequencies that can send and receive signals from Create's Redstone Links! Internally named L1-L20

hotspots.title: Wireless Copycats
hotspots.body: Set up to 100 alphanumeric frequencies with my own Wireless Copycat blocks! Requires Create. These wireless upgrades of normal Copycat blocks can send / receive different redstone signals on each side. Behaves like a normal Copycat otherwise

hotspots.title: Import Typewriter Data
hotspots.body: You can click here to import Redstone Link frequencies and keybinds directly from a Typewriter that is placed within 20 blocks away. Easy upgrade!

hotspots.title: Peripheral Manager
hotspots.body: View all of your peripheral links made in Linking Mode. This is the first of a few planned steps to improve the ease-of-use around Linking Mode. More to come.

hotspots.title: Gamepad Calibration
hotspots.body: This screen lets you re-calibrate your gamepad's analog sticks. Helpful if you have an older, worn out controller that cant hit every corner of the input anymore. Most people can ignore this.

hotspots.title: Reset Keyboard Data
hotspots.body: Reset all data, or just the peripheral links (helpful when you print a schematic, and need to relink the peripherals without erasing the other settings)

hotspots.title: << Tab
hotspots.body: Pressing 'tab' on your keyboard goes back from any menu. Or press here
